description_en: Queries the list of resource export tasks
description_zh: 查询资源导出任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice list-resource-export-tasks --keyword key --export-task-id ex-al1c11jl9g2tbte727otp85 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceExportTasks

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy search by task name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持对任务名称的模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource export task
parameters.name: export_task_id

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的结果数量。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：100
parameters.name: page_size

createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

description.description_en: The description of the export task

exportStatus.description_en:
The export status. Valid values:

Queue: queued
Pending: preparing to run
Success: succeeded
Errored: failed
Canceled: canceled
exportStatus.description_zh:
导出状态

Queue：排队中
Pending：准备运行
Success：运行成功
Errored：运行错误
Canceled：被取消

exportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the resource export task

exportToModule.description_en: The module to which the exported template is saved. If this parameter is not set, the template is automatically saved in the Registry
exportToModule.description_zh: 将导出后的模板保存为Module。 如果未设置，那么将自动保存在Registry中

source.description_en:
The module type to which the exported template is saved. Valid values:

OSS: OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry
source.description_zh:
导出后的模板保存的Module类型。可选值：

OSS ：OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry

sourcePath.description_en:
The path where the template content is saved.

If Source is set to Registry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

If Source is set to OSS, the format is: "oss::https://.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
sourcePath.description_zh:
保存模板内容的路径值

当 Source 为 Registry 时，格式为： "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"

statePath.description_en: The path where the template state file is saved
statePath.description_zh: 保存模板State文件的路径值

includeRules.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
includeRules.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

items.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
items.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

key.description_en:
The name of the include rule for resource export. Valid values:

ResourceType: required. The resource type, such as ALIYUN::VPC::VPC.
RegionId: required. The region to which the resource belongs. Only one region is supported, such as ap-southeast-1.
\<ResourceType>:Id: the resource ID, such as ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id.
ResourceGroupId: the resource group ID, such as rg-1234.
ZoneId: the zone to which the resource belongs. Only one zone is supported, such as ap-southeast-1h.

By default, the relationship between multiple filter conditions is AND. A resource is considered matched only when all filter conditions are met
key.description_zh:
资源导出时的包含规则名称。可选值如下：

ResourceType：必填，资源类型，例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC
RegionId：必填，资源所属Region，当前只支持一个Region，例如：cn-chengdu
\<ResourceType>:Id：资源ID,例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id
ResourceGroupId：资源组ID，例如：rg-1234
ZoneId：资源所属Zone，目前只支持一个Zone，例如：cn-hangzhou-h

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件

values.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
values.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

items.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
items.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

modules.description_en: The module configuration of the exported resources

items.description_en: The module configuration of the exported resources

source.description_en: The module type where the exported template is stored. Two formats are supported: CloudRegistry and OSS. If the ExportToModule parameter is specified, both formats are returned. Otherwise, only CloudRegistry is returned
source.description_zh: 导出后的模板所在的Module类型，目前有两种格式：CloudRegistry 和OSS。如果客户指定了参数 ExportToModule，那么这两种都将返回，否则只返回 CloudRegistry

sourcePath.description_en:
The download URL of the module where the exported template is stored.

If Source is set to CloudRegistry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice/<exportTaskId>/<Provider Name>"

If Source is set to OSS, the format is: "oss::https://<BucketName>.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
sourcePath.description_zh:
导出后的模板所在的Module下的下载地址。
 
当 Source 为 CloudRegistry 时，格式为：
"cloudregistry::iacservice/<exportTaskId>/<Provider Name>"

当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://<BucketName>.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"

version.description_en: The version of the module where the exported template is stored
version.description_zh: 导出后的模板所在的Module的版本

name.description_en: The name of the export task

status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Available: available
Running: running
status.description_zh:
任务状态

Available：可用状态
Running：运行状态

variables.description_en: The list of variables. The parameters of the exported resources are set as variables
variables.description_zh: 变量列表，将资源导出后的参数设置为变量

items.description_en: The list of variables. The parameters of the exported resources are set as variables
items.description_zh: 变量列表，将资源导出后的参数设置为变量

properties.description_en: The list of Terraform resource properties corresponding to the resource type
properties.description_zh: 资源类型对应的Terraform资源的属性列表

items.description_en: The Terraform resource property corresponding to the resource type
items.description_zh: 资源类型对应的Terraform资源的属性

pageSize.description_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
pageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的结果数量。默认值：20，最小值：1，最大值：100
